title: Lists selector has a blank selection on a fresh installation
reproduction: Set QSHOPPER_DATA_DIR to a new disposable directory and launch application.exe.
Open the drawer using the editor's menu button.
Inspect the Lists combo box without selecting another list.
actual: The Lists combo box displays no selected text, although the default list is active.
expected: The Lists combo box displays default and selects the active list when the drawer opens.
suspected_cause: Confirmed: Theme.activeList initially stores the alias default, whereas the Lists selector matches UUID values. The model already resolves the alias to the actual list UUID; the selector previously ignored that resolved identity.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh installation displays default as the current list.
Selecting another list updates both the displayed selection and shopping contents.
Reopening the drawer and restarting the app preserve the correct selection.
Add a regression test using isolated data and settings.
evidence: Observed in a visible Windows app run on 2026-10-03. See tests/README.md, UI behavior verification.

implementation.change: After the shopping model resolves the initial default alias, persist its actual UUID in Theme.activeList. Bind the Lists ComboBox currentValue directly to Theme.activeList, replacing duplicate count/completion index assignments. Existing UUID selections and the zero-UUID lists-management entry retain their meaning.
implementation.design: Keep list identity separate from its display name. No changes to shopping order, editor workflow, gestures, sizing or styling.
implementation.regression: tests/qml/tst_listselection.qml opens the actual drawer through the editor menu button and selects popup rows by pointer. It verifies initial default display, switching between lists with distinct contents, reopening the drawer, persisted settings read in a fresh QQmlEngine, a recreated app window, the lists-management entry, and selector refresh after adding a list. tests/test_ui.cpp adds the fresh-engine setting reader.
implementation.before: With the original source, two of six focused QTest records fail: fresh default selection and refresh retaining default selection. Existing list switching/restoration and lists-management selection controls pass.
implementation.windows_after: All six focused records pass offscreen and with real Windows rendering. The normal configure/build/CTest workflow passes all three suites: 108 UI, 6 keyboard and 61 model records. UI duration: 166.94 seconds; total: 173.37 seconds.
implementation.android_after: All ten checks pass using tests/android/test_popups.py --selector lists --restart on emulator-5580. For both default and the special lists entry, verify fresh initial selection, safe endpoint reachability, persisted selection, unchanged shopping contents, and the displayed selection after a real force-stop/cold restart. Data/settings are disposable and isolated.
